title: maint.event.v1{kind=pii_erased}
description: Phase 8 §8.3 / Phase 7 §7.1 — emitted by maint.backup.v1 after handling a `quarantine_erase` operator request. The `request_id` correlates back to the originating `quarantine_erase` envelope so the audit trail is end-to-end.

client_id.description: Data-subject id (the `target` of the originating quarantine_erase).

table.description: Table name whose rows were tombstoned (e.g. `quarantine_samples`).
